Any ruler faces lairs of various monsters sooner or later. Such lairs should be destroyed for the sake of kingdom and its citizens.
It was a cosy peasant house once. Now harpies dwell in it.
The lodge where the guards are resting. You can seize the tower by destroying the lodge.
Here live the peasants that are patronised by Agrella's church.

Shoots accurately over long distances. Moves very quickly. Plays musical instruments.
A barbarian who became attracted by the idea of fair elections. He's hungry and aggressive.

Your Majesty! With this order you'll reach the maximum number of buildings. You won't be able to build any more until you destroy one of the constructed buildings. Unless of course before the enemies do that for you!
Your Majesty! You've enlisted the last of your free heroes. You won't be able to hire other heroes before you retire one of your current ones.

Your Majesty, the demented paladinesses have been thrown down. Apparently, they'd simply got bored without their husbands who have been at war a long way away for several years already. There's a suggestion we should bind them to the temple of the Discord Warriors' barracks, or else the women can't spend their lives either warring or praying.

Your Majesty, the royal weather forecasters report mass natural fires sweeping across the small immigrant settlement. The foreigners without pausing for thought have left their houses and settled in the neighboring kingdoms. The guilds have doubled their billing rates but in acknowledgement of your firm actions aimed at protecting the national interests the royal court is now receiving an unheard-of 2% discount on all services for the next month!

Your Majesty, it is my privilege to report you good tidings - the vampires have happily been impaled with wooden stakes, and their remains have been processed for the benefit of tanners and dentists. The money is still missing from the treasury, but I, together with the treasurer, have defined another group of suspects - it's werewolves, ogres, minotaurs and possibly dragons.

It's a triumph of morals, your Majesty! No more men will succumb to the idea of choral singing, especially if they see the heads of the warrior and his disciples blending with the architectural complex of the royal palace.

Congratulations your Majesty! The people look like people again, and skeletons again look like skeletons. In addition, our economy is on the rise mainly due to the rabbit breeding sector. For the time when skeletons were rabbits, their population has become a dozen times bigger! Their progeny remains cute, fluffy and tasty. Oh, your meat-pie is ready and will soon be served, enjoy your meal.

Your Majesty, it's fantastic! I've watched the games broadcast via magic sphere - the Greedy Misers clan took first place by a long way thanks to our help. There's also bad news, though - the Chieftain sent us a sack of coal and informed that in the Dwarven culture diamonds and coal are generally of the same value. By and large, I'm afraid we'll never get anything from the Greedy Misers, who would have thought it?!

Great! Your artful plan to defect to the golems succeeded - now not only the remainder but all the dragons' riches are going to the royal treasury. The golems thank you for your support and vow fidelity.
The result surpassed all expectations - the golems are ground into dust and the dragons are very satisfied and say they're very proud to have such a caring King as you.

Sire, the danger has passed. The healers are committed to merciful torture, the gnomes and barbarians thank you for their deliverance from harmful ideas. I think these innocent souls are not guilty in succumbing to the pernicious impact of the healers. To put new heart into them, I suggest cancelling today's gnome executions and to double the barbarians rations.

Your Majesty! We've found out why the caravans had got lost. It emerged that it was Golems who robbed the merchants. It's rather strange because Golems usually keep away from roads and settlements. For all their immoral deeds I've signed an edict according to which Golems are no longer in the Royal Red List. Let that be a lesson to others. And the stolen ink is already on the town marketplace - thank God, delations flow like water again!

Your Majesty, the Supreme Wizard has been defeated. Only death could calm the madman down and put an end to the destroying of the kingdom. Despite his scary threats and bad behavior, in recognition of his past services he'll be buried with all due honors, each piece in a different place, so that hostile necromancers wouldn't find his body. By the way, the idea of handing out biscuits as the salary to your subjects was remarkable!

Your Majesty, the vampire village has been wiped off the face of the earth, all the vampires have been destroyed, as well as their castle. This behavior is very strange for vampires - they rarely leave their ancient castles and certainly they haven't tried to settle in an out-of-the-way hamlet. But now the trouble is behind us. After a while peasants will come to this place again, rebuild the village and start paying taxes properly as they did before. By the way, here I have a present for you - it's a necklace of vampire fangs, I made it myself. Our sorcerers assure me that it's an excellent charm. Oh, and we've floated a rumor that at midnight vampires attack those who don't pay their taxes in time.

Your Majesty, our dashing troops have repulsed the sudden attack and destroyed the enemy. The leader of the goblins tried to surrender with a white flag between his teeth but we got the hang of his artful maneuver This flag became his shroud. Unfortunately, my valiant relatives died in battle, but I'll be sure to set up monuments to them on their land that is now going to be mine.

Your Majesty, in the course of the Northern Campaign our troops have won the first battle on the road to opening up and conquering the new territories. Golems are strong and crafty enemies but in spite of it the royal army passed with flying colors After a short rest they'll be ready to continue the march. By your order we haven't made fires to prevent the warriors from getting drunk together, and we tied them together so that they don't get lost.

Your Majesty, it turned out that it wasn't dead but quite alive, angry and hungry red dragons. However, at the cost of the warriors' and painters' lives we defeated them, and now this place can after all be named the "Cemetery of Red Dragons". One of the wounded dragons tried to run from the battlefield, but our warriors followed his tracks and discovered a really amazing thing. They found the lair of the Great Dragon himself. Your scientists say this breed hasn't been found in nature for about 1000 years. At first the votaries of science refused to go and study the dragon but under pain of death and torture they agreed. What strange people, they don't want to do anything without torture, or maybe they just like it?

Your Majesty, under your wise command the army have displayed courage in struggling against this unfamiliar enemy and indeed they've gained a glorious victory. The Northern lands are captured, all enemies are defeated and the kingdom is now bigger and richer. Our scientists confirmed that the Great Dragon was responsible for all our recent misfortunes. The madness of your father Roderick I is now considered the dragon's fault, too. Now the former king can be rehabilitated. I've already prepared the edict on giving him a title of National Hero and putting up a monument to him. We've declared a national holiday and people are enjoying themselves and holding street festivities.

aActs: The dragon's remains were used to make a new carriage for you, it's coal-black with a dragon-ish tint. Although during its creation two groups of masters have died, one building has been burnt down and one horse herd have inexplicably become rabid, on the whole it's a wonderful present, enough to make your neighboring kings jealous. By the way, they all showed their willingness to come here after the war and congratulate you on the victory. But before accepting their proposal I'd suggest you to hint at them to bring food and drinks . They won't leave here until they eat up everything anyway.

Singing a song: Your Majesty, I have great news! We managed to find the dragon's gold and return it to the royal treasury, although it should be mentioned that a portion of the gold deteriorated because of improper storage and I personally had to utilize it. The dragon repented and henceforth swears to take taxes seriously. As for the princess, she probably found a younger dragon.

Your Majesty, I have great news! We managed to find the dragon's gold and return it to the royal treasury, although it should be mentioned that a portion of the gold deteriorated because of improper storage and I personally had to utilize it. The dragon was shot in an attempt to escape and the princess, unfortunately, managed to sneak off.

For good reason paladinesses are considered to be elite warriors. They've easily put our troops to flight and now they're heading for the castle. I suggest you tighten your chastity belt, or Your Majesty risks dying in the throes.

I'm offering an abject apology, but the immigrants, outraged by your intolerant treatment, have risen in rebellion and sent away all local guilds outside the Kingdom. But the worst news for you is that they've just elected a new king, and now that I've passed on that message, please have the courtesy to return the crown and vacate the premises within the hour.

Your Majesty, it turned out that the problem with vampires was somewhat overstated. I'm sure you'll get bored listening to all the tiresome details of this matter, so it will be much quicker if I just bite you...

It's a disaster! The shameless warriors grew weary of orgies in the backwoods, broke into the towns and enacted new laws there. On this occasion, I can finally do a thing I dreamt of for many years on royal service - I propose marriage to your Majesty!

Your Majesty, the necromancer's servants have resurrected their sovereign! Your army have defected to him and any minute the horde of merciless monsters will burst into the throne room. I hope Mr necromancer needs a wise advisor...

Your Majesty, despite our efforts the Greedy Misers clan lost in the final. As a result, their chieftain insisted on considering people as monsters again, and they now can be hunted on the games. The final will be played again according to the new rules. Save yourself, the dwarves are already breaking our gate!

Your Majesty, unfortunately, things have taken a turn for the worse. The dragons have made their peace with the golems and decided to breed virgins right in the Kingdom capital. All pure and photogenic people are ordered to report to the veterinary service at once to undergo a breed test and be stamped accordingly. And the ones who are not fertile are welcomed at the fertilizer farm.

It's terrible your Worship! Our reconnaissance party are defeated, our spies fled, and the free-thinkers organized... excuse this repulsive word... elections. One of the healers became the president, a gnome is now his prime-minister and a barbarian is a general. Other residents received their posts. For example, I'm a potter's apprentice and you're a junior sewage pipe cleaner.

Unfortunately, the cause of the loss of caravans hasn't been found. We ran out of our ink supply, and the kingdom has been plunged into chaos. But the worst thing for you is that you can't even sign a document declaring your non-participation in what has happened!

Your Majesty, the deadly spells have finally reached us. Our castle is destroyed, all your subjects stopped breathing and died and the kingdom is left in ruins. The Supreme Wizard is probably pleased with himself... Oh, how clear the air has become! Don't you think?
Your Majesty, we lost, vampires spread all over the kingdom, and we managed to evacuate only your harem and wine cellar.
You didn't manage to repulse the attack, the goblins destroyed your troops and captured the kingdom.
Sire! Unfortunately, all our warriors caught laryngopharyngotracheitis and we lost the battle.

The red dragons appeared to be much stronger than our army. They've defeated our troops and now they're marching to our border. The royal castle is going to turn into a flare soon. All your guards have deserted their posts and jumped into the baths. Maybe we should follow suit?
The Great Dragon appeared to be too strong an enemy for us. Having destroyed your troops and had a snack with captives, he fell asleep again for another thousand years.
Your Majesty, I have bad news... The dragon insolently refused to pay taxes, ate your murd... pathfinders and... er... well, he is already here, and he's going to tell you everything himself.
Do you want to replay the mission?

Sire, I have alarming news from the Dauros temple, the sacred citadel of our paladinesses. A few days ago the viragoes mutinied and plundered the temple, covered their nails with war paint and went to the forest. Some very curious elves caught them fraternizing with goblins. They're constantly drinking ale and indulging in various vices. From time to time they're robbing tax-collectors and ravaging marketplaces.

aActs: Among the traitors there is my dear cousin of the aunt of the brother of my mother-in-law's grandfather of my godfather, but nevertheless I beg you to execute all the mutineers! Meanwhile I'll go and make a new will...

Singing a song: Your Majesty, pardon me for diverting you from your morning soufflé, but there are a huge crowd of your subjects at the gates. They have presented a petition which demands you take notice of the problem of illegal immigrants who have recently overcrowded the Kingdom. These foreigners undertake the raising of skeletons, preaching and stealing for peanuts, taking all the work from our respected necromancers, preachers and thieves! The most active patriots are ready to solve the problem themselves, you see, these people with pitchforks and torches. In general, I think now is a good time to support this timely initiative at a grass roots level.

Your Majesty, another mishap has befallen us! Money is constantly going missing from our treasury. I, together with the main treasurer, have thought it over and concluded that it's the vampires' fault. First of all, they are evil and rich, it's widely known. Secondly, they are strange and they drink blood. Thirdly, there are too many of them of late. The only logical solution to this situation is to exterminate their nasty brotherhood and hope that this will help.

Your Majesty, a famous warrior has climbed down the Gibbous mountains and turned up in our lands. He's recruiting all interested men as disciples. Everyone has to vow celibacy and leave their family to settle in the backwoods with the other disciples. The number of these free-thinkers is growing. They eat out of the same cauldron, drink out of the same bottle, hold hands and even sing in chorus. All in all, this directly undermines the demographic nature of the Kingdom and slackens the moral principles of your subjects! The warrior together with his disciples must be caught and married off, or at least slaughtered so it doesn't become a habit.

Your Majesty, have you already looked at yourself in the mirror today? No, please don't do that - an evil necromancer has turned all the Kingdom's inhabitants into terrible skeletons. There is an advantage, though, the side effect of this spell has turned all the terrible skeletons into cute rabbits, but it's cold comfort. After committing his malicious act, the necromancer died in the throes, and his loyal servants quickly took his remains away to secluded heathen temples. The situation seems oppressive but there's a small chance to overcome it - our learned wizards think that if we put all the necromancer's parts together, the spell will be cancelled. I think we should start doing this immediately.

Your Majesty, a delegation of dwarves have just arrived led by the Chieftain of the Greedy Misers clan. The thing is that the Pan-Dwarven Monster-hunting games will be held soon. The winning clan in these games is the one which kills the most monsters. To succeed, the clans can take any means, and the Chieftain is asking for our help in the final game. He also reminds us that he was once the initiator who excluded people from the category of monsters. As a reward for our participation in the games he promises to send us a sack of diamonds after the victory. He also hints that he won't get upset if the competitive Fierce Goldlovers clan is completely eliminated during the games. The deal seems to be profitable!

Your Majesty, a dragon visited us recently. We extended hospitality to him and offered him the usual set of virgins and cattle but he unexpectedly refused the refreshments and demanded an audience with you. The point is that a small but assiduous community of law-abiding dragons on the outlying districts are in danger. A gang of inveterate golem scoundrels threaten them. Golems have terrorized the neighborhood for a long time, they steal thoroughbred virgins from the dragons' farms. If things stay the same, the dragons will be reduced to penury and die of starvation. With the remainder of their riches the unhappy farmers want to hire several brave mercenaries. But I'm sure many of our subjects would like to take up the call without seeking to profit, and it would be honorable of you to formalize this noble impulse as an order. The remainder of the riches is already on its way to the royal treasury.

Your Majesty, the sovereign tyranny is in danger! Our spies report that the healers guild are instigating gnomes and barbarians to demand the improvement of working conditions and even a salary - it's unprecedented! The gnomes always had the absence of beating as the highest reward, and the barbarians were formerly satisfied with a big piece of brisket. These were our national traditions, and to waive them would betray everything our ancestors had fought for! We must stamp out this mutinous attitude for the sake of all that is good.

Your Majesty, we're having trouble again. The traders' guild inform us that caravans with the necessary goods have stopped coming to the town. It never happened even under your late father, peace to his ashes. If we don't solve the problem we'll find ourselves without vital goods. We will be able to do without food and medicine, but if the castle runs out of ink, the kingdom will be plunged into chaos. The folk won't have anything to write delations with, tax-collectors and money-lenders won't be able to seize debtors' property, and I won't be able to prepare death warrants for your signature. I'm afraid we'll have to write on walls and fences as there are enough inscriptions already.

Your Majesty! Our unchallenged Supreme Wizard, honorary member of the Magic Academy and choir's soloist, who served Ardania and the Crown faithfully for many years, has officially gone off his head. He smashed up his laboratory, cursed his secretary and went away to his country tower. Moreover, he cast the spell which turned all gold and jewelery in your treasure house into biscuits. Your golden hall now looks like a gingerbread cottage. This morning he sent us a haughty harpy with a written demand, quote: "I order all the <censored> people of Ardania including its <censored> king to stop breathing within seven days because I'm allergic to the air you spoil, else I, the Greatest Wizard, will destroy your <censored> kingdom" unquote. To prove his intention to be firm, he burnt down a village! Though this village wasn't ours, but he doesn't know that yet. In addition, he's regularly casting baneful spells on your warriors. The other wizards are containing his mad rage for now but they won't hold out long because the spells are becoming more powerful day by day. Oh, you should definitely taste the biscuits! They're delicious, just like my late Grandmother baked.

Your Majesty, our head tax-collector has just returned from a remote village and brings bad news. He says that instead of the rural idyll he discovered a strange black castle right in the center of the village and there wasn't a soul on the streets. He checked all the houses and found out that previously law-abiding taxpayers had turned into vampires. But our tax-collector didn't get frightened by them (the sun was shining bright then) and took in all the taxes. Your Majesty, the presence of vampire villages is unacceptable in our kingdom because it is known for certain that vampires never pay taxes.

Sire, an unforeseen error has occurred My report about eliminating the threat from goblins was criminally optimistic. Yesterday night goblins from the neighboring state crossed our border and treacherously attacked us! Now they're conquering village after village eating up and robbing every living and not-nailed-down thing on their way. Your Majesty, I've made a terrible mistake, and my family is disgraced. Let me wash my guilt away with blood - my two relatives dreamt of joining the troops, fighting on the front line and dying for their King! Please, do them this honor!

Your Majesty, the recent goblin attack was nearly crowned a success. This army was the biggest and most organized of all they've ever got together. Our council suppose the cause of all our troubles is in the North, outside our borders. To prevent further attacks, we need to get our troops together and march off to explore, occupy and annex the northern territories to our kingdom. A beautiful land is there, with rivers, forests, mountains... We may build there your winter residence and a ski resort.

Your Majesty, new territories keep surprising us with their beauty and sights. At dawn your warriors discovered an absolute miracle - the cemetery of red dragons who are preserved quite well in such cold climate areas. If it pleases you we'll halt a while as the warriors want to make several portraits with mountains and dragons in the background.

Sire, our scientists and wizards have conducted the research on the Great Dragon and diagnosed lichen, haemorrhoids and prostatitis. Besides, over his long life he's accumulated a lot of magic, anger and complexes, and even in his sleep he contrives to give vent to others' bile. As he can't be trained to dream about anything good and useful, for the sake of the kingdom the dragon must be eliminated.

Your Majesty, the royal tax collector has just reported that a local dragon, not willing to pay taxes for the last 100 years, fled from his lair together with a princess to an undisclosed location. But he's one of the main taxpayers of the Kingdom! Our economy is in peril! In addition, if we forgive this one, every nasty vampire, ogre or lord of darkness would shrug off your laws with perfect impunity. We must send the troop of murd... I mean, the troop of pathfinders to find the runaways and your gold.
Define a reward for the flags

So, you've ruled for several years over the kingdom you'd inherited from your late father Roderick I. During these years you proved yourself to be a wise and just regent who's able to cope with any disaster that befalls the kingdom. The rats are defeated and annihilated, goblins have been taken in hand, dwarves properly supply the court with excellent ale. Even the dragons accepted the rule that murder and destroying of villages is forbidden, and have flown to the mountains. But the quiet and steady life doesn't suit you. Young blood seethes in veins and thirsts for senseless murders and destruction. In the evenings you wistfully gaze northwards drinking another keg of ale. The court scientists say those parts of the world have useful lands and mysterious creatures to be conquered. You imagine heaps of defeated enemies, the smoking ruins of their dwellings, piles of captured treasures and your renewed harem. Then Your Majesty is falling asleep after making his head comfortable right in the hors d'oeuvre. The crown is slipping off your head, rolling along the table and falling with a clang onto the floor full of leftovers. You start dreaming about a throne of black gold in which you're sitting solemnly. In your right hand you're holding a troll's head, a harpy settled on the left one. A necklace of vampire fangs is shining around your neck.

Welcome to tutorial level of Majesty game. Here you'll learn to construct buildings, hire heroes, use magic etc.
The buildings are the base of your might. Constructed buildings define the classes of available heroes, spells, weapon upgrades, etc.
Hire three more warriors so their total number is four.
Now you have four heroes and you can upgrade your Castle. Click on the castle or castle icon at the bottom right corner of the screen and press flashing button with number II.
Your Castle is upgraded to the 2nd level and now new buildings are available for construction. Select and build a Wizard guild.

As the Wizard guild is ready, the spells "Explore" and "Invisibility" are available. "Explore" spell reveals the specified dark spot of the map, "Invisibility" spell temporary makes any hero or monster invisible.

Open the magic menu from the bottom left corner. Click the icon for the "Explore" spell, then click on any unexplored part of the map twice. The dark spot of a certain radius around your click will be revealed.
Only two spells are available to a 1st level Wizard guild. Upgrade the guild to 2nd and 3rd levels to access the remaining spells.
Let's start with construction of a basic building Warrior guild where we may hire the warriors. Select a castle on the map or click the castle button in the bottom right corner of the screen.
Press the button near the house icon on the popped up castle screen.
You're now shown a list of available buildings. Click twice on the button marked Warrior guild.

Click on the map to select the location to build a Warrior guild. The red tiles mean that it's impossible to build here and you should select another location for building. Click twice on the map to begin construction at the selected location.
So, the Warrior guild is ready. Now click on the constructed building and hire one warrior. Click the "plus" icon next to the warrior to hire him.

So, your first hero is ready for adventures. You cannot control him - he decides where to go and what to do on his own. Build the blacksmith's to make your hero buy new weapons and armour. Build a marketplace to make him buy healing potions.

Use the "Attack flag" to make units attack a special monster or monster lair. Click on the lair and select the icon with two swords to mark this lair with an "Attack flag". Use plus or minus to define the sum of reward for destroying this lair. The higher the sum is, the better the chance that the heroes become interested in this reward. Set a reward of 1000 gold coins and click on the cross to close the window. Wait until the heroes come to destroy the lair.

You can assign the "Scouting flag" in the same way to make the heroes visit the spot on the map and explore the unexplored areas. Click twice on the map spot to set the "Scouting flag". Click twice at a monster or lair to mark it with an "Attack flag".
